Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no readable screens, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.

provenance.notes: Generated illustration of an invented public plaza; no real photograph, artwork, logo or lettering was used. The curved wall is blank; no screen content is drawn. The open white sails, coral awnings and absence of a roofed building keep it apart from the Amphitheater, Forum and Television Station. Some keyed fringing is possible around the thin rigging lines, so it was checked at zoom.
